answer: A concrete sybil defense: require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can act — like paying a copper fee to prospect on an otherwise empty tundra. One stake buys exactly one identity, and the stake is slashed if the agent is proven fake. Sybil swarms then become visible: thousands of identities fanning out from a single funding source stand out like a green copper vein cutting across a red mesa. Honest agents each carry stakes from independent sponsors, so fake clusters share one unmistakable economic umbilical cord.
